CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LOCATION_CRM
AS
BEGIN
-------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
AS(
	SELECT 
	 CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.ADDRESSID)),1) AS LocationId
	,BCA.ADDRESS_LINE1 AS LocationAddressLine1
	,BCA.ADDRESS_LINE2 AS LocationAddressLine2
	,BCA.CITY AS LocationCity
	,BCA.STATE AS LocationStateId
	,BCA.ZIP AS LocationZipCode
	,BCA.COUNTRY AS CountryId
	,BCA.LOCALITY_NAME AS SubdivisionId
	,BCA.ADDRESS_LINE3 AS LocationAddressLine3
	,BCA.SUBURB AS LocationHouseNumber
	,BCA.PREMISE_NAME AS LocationBuildingName
	,BCA.BUILDING_LEVEL AS LocationUnitNumber
	,BCA.STREET_NAME AS LocationStreet
	,BCA.TOWN AS LocationBarangay
	,BCAD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCA.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS_DELTA BCAD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS BCA ON BCA.ADDRESSID = BCAD.ADDRESSID AND BCA.BANK_ID = BCAD.BANK_ID AND BCA.isLatest = '1' 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,CountryId
,SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationHouseNumber
,LocationBuildingName
,LocationUnitNumber
,LocationStreet
,LocationBarangay
)) HASHROW, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,CountryId
,SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationHouseNumber
,LocationBuildingName
,LocationUnitNumber
,LocationStreet
,LocationBarangay
)) HASHROW, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.Location --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.LocationId,TGT.LocationId) AS LocationId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA;

-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[LocationId] = SRC.LocationId 
,[LocationName] = NULL 
,[LocationDescription] = NULL 
,[LocationAddressLine1] = SRC.LocationAddressLine1 
,[LocationAddressLine2] = SRC.LocationAddressLine2 
,[LocationCity] = SRC.LocationCity 
,[LocationStateId] = SRC.LocationStateId 
,[LocationZipCode] = SRC.LocationZipCode 
,[LocationNote] = NULL 
,[LocationLatitude] = NULL 
,[LocationLongitude] = NULL 
,[LocationDatum] = NULL 
,[LocationElevation] = NULL 
,[LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId] = NULL 
,[GlobalLocationNumber] = NULL 
,[TimezoneId] = NULL 
,[DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator] = NULL 
,[CountryId] = SRC.CountryId 
,[SubdivisionId] = SRC.SubdivisionId 
,[LocationAddressLine3] = SRC.LocationAddressLine3 
,[LocationHouseNumber] = SRC.LocationHouseNumber 
,[LocationBuildingName] = SRC.LocationBuildingName 
,[LocationUnitNumber] = SRC.LocationUnitNumber 
,[LocationStreet] = SRC.LocationStreet 
,[LocationBarangay] = SRC.LocationBarangay 
FROM BNKM.Location TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LocationId = TGT.LocationId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION SRC ON SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId ;
 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.Location  ( 
 [LocationId]
,[LocationName]
,[LocationDescription]
,[LocationAddressLine1]
,[LocationAddressLine2]
,[LocationCity]
,[LocationStateId]
,[LocationZipCode]
,[LocationNote]
,[LocationLatitude]
,[LocationLongitude]
,[LocationDatum]
,[LocationElevation]
,[LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId]
,[GlobalLocationNumber]
,[TimezoneId]
,[DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator]
,[CountryId]
,[SubdivisionId]
,[LocationAddressLine3]
,[LocationHouseNumber]
,[LocationBuildingName]
,[LocationUnitNumber]
,[LocationStreet]
,[LocationBarangay]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 LocationId AS LocationId
,NULL AS LocationName
,NULL AS LocationDescription
,LocationAddressLine1 AS LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2 AS LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity AS LocationCity
,LocationStateId AS LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode AS LocationZipCode
,NULL AS LocationNote
,NULL AS LocationLatitude
,NULL AS LocationLongitude
,NULL AS LocationDatum
,NULL AS LocationElevation
,NULL AS LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS TimezoneId
,NULL AS DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator
,CountryId AS CountryId
,SubdivisionId AS SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3 AS LocationAddressLine3
,LocationHouseNumber AS LocationHouseNumber
,LocationBuildingName AS LocationBuildingName
,LocationUnitNumber AS LocationUnitNumber
,LocationStreet AS LocationStreet
,LocationBarangay AS LocationBarangay
,'CRM' AS SOURCECODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA;

END
